footer: Compiled from Reuters, BBC, Polygon, Federal Reserve, TechCrunch and India Meteorological Department reports filed on 19 November 2026 (morning, WIB).
sources_note: All seven stories were reported on 19 November 2026; the Trump-Xi-Putin meeting and India-Japan talks are scheduled events taking place on 19 November, with outcomes still to be reported.

stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen in first trilateral summit
stories.summary: The three leaders are due to meet for an hour on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, with nuclear arms, Iran and Ukraine on the agenda; all three capitals confirmed the first such meeting.

stories.headline: Iran hits US base in Kuwait as Gulf attacks widen
stories.summary: Iran said its drones hit US Patriot batteries and launch platforms at Ali Al-Salem Air Base in Kuwait. Kuwait said its air defences engaged the drones and reported no damage.

stories.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI begins global rollout after 13-year wait
stories.summary: Rockstar's game unlocked at midnight local time on 19 November, starting in New Zealand and rolling around the world on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Pre-orders topped an estimated 15.88 million units.

stories.headline: Fed minutes point to more rate hikes; stocks slide, gold tumbles
stories.summary: Minutes showed almost all Fed officials saw further rate rises as likely, and Governor Waller pushed for a half-point hike in December; the S&P 500 fell 0.23% and gold slid 3.3% to $3,724.

stories.headline: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 in record AI debut
stories.summary: The Claude maker priced its IPO at $83 a share, above its $70-$78 range, in one of the largest listings on record. Shares are due to start trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday under the ticker ANT.

stories.headline: Cyclone Akvan nears India coast as red alerts go out
stories.summary: Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan sat about 500 km off India's east coast, with extremely heavy rain warned for 19-20 November. Red alerts cover six Odisha districts; schools shut.

stories.headline: India and Japan hold 2+2 defence talks in Tokyo
stories.source: Press Information Bureau / Hindu BusinessLine, 19 Nov 2026
stories.summary: Foreign and defence ministers meet in Tokyo to review defence equipment, maritime security and joint exercises, reaffirming a free and open Indo-Pacific. It is the fourth 2+2 round.
